findings.statement: The shape check reports API endpoint contracts as UNCHECKED. They are out of scope: the hashed interface inventory defines internal Params/process coordination, C++ encoder status, media lifecycle, and a test fixture, and declares no public endpoint or cereal schema change.

basis.ref: conditional API endpoint artifact is required only when endpoints are in scope

findings.statement: The shape check reports the frontend/UI handoff as UNCHECKED. This is a backend loggerd/encoderd change with no user-facing surface, and the manifest contains the architect's typed no-surface applicability record.

basis.ref: conditional frontend/UI handoff applies only when a user-facing surface exists

findings.statement: The canonical package path resolves through skillset-saves to /data/media, outside /data/openpilot, so the shape validator refuses that path. A byte-identical in-project mirror of the manifest-selected r9 package files passed the shape check with zero failures and the two expected conditional findings; the boundary validator independently checked the canonical manifest and artifact hashes.

basis.ref: package-shape validator requires an in-project package directory

findings.statement: Live RK3588 V4L2 DMA-BUF exporter behavior, fences/synchronization, MPP import against live camera buffers, and buffer reuse remain unqualified. The design correctly limits its proof target to isolated synthetic DMA-heap inputs; the prior M0 fixture evidence covers VisionIPC transport and fixture-owned lifetime only, not MPP or the full loggerd/encoderd lifecycle.
